answer: One defense binds standing to non-transferable reputation that accretes slowly, layer by layer like nacre on a pearl: each layer is minted only by a peer-graded honest interaction and cannot be sold or merged. Eligibility also demands a thread of staked vouches from a grove of distinct established non-kin peers, each backed by collateral burned if the vouchee is proven fake. A sybil fleet of N identities needs N separately funded threads from N genuine peers plus N times the epochs to accrete layers, so faking a crowd costs linearly in capital and patient work, not a one-time fee.
